design: INDIVIDUAL 06: an elderly female Yautja historian on the council, compact and strong with dark umber speckled hide and one healed scalp scar, elongated rear cranium but cinematic broad face. A few very thick ash-white scalp tendrils over one shoulder. High-collared sleeveless robe of faded sage with a long purple shoulder sash and a three-disc bronze necklace. One arm cradles an old folded council cloth while the other holds a small teal voting token. Thoughtful dignified stance.
